en.bdb: The condition of the special addicts

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੀ ਖਾਸੇ ਮਜਲਸੀ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: amalee khaase majalasee piram piaalaa alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: The special admirers gathered in the assembly (holy congregation), through the cup of love have beholden the imperceptible (Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲਾ ਤਸਬੀ ਤੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਜਿਉਂ ਸਉ ਤਿਵੈਂ ਅਠੋਤਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: maalaa tasabee toR kai jiau(n) sau tivai(n) aThotar laiaa|

en.bdb: They break the restriction of beads (Muslim rosary) and for them the number of beads as hundred or one hundred and eight are immaterial.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੁ ਇਮਾਮ ਰਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mer imaam ralai kai raam raheem na naau ganaiaa|

en.bdb: They combine Meru (the last bead of Hindu rosary) and Imam (the last bead of Muslim roasary) and keep no distinction between Ram and Rahim (as names of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਜੂਦੁ ਹੁਇ ਚਉਪੜ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਜੁੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhui mil ik vajoodh hui chaupaR saaree joR juRaiaa|

en.bdb: Joining together they become one body and consider this world as the game of oblong dice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee no la(n)gh kai piram piaale nij ghar aaiaa|

en.bdb: Transcending the illusory phenomenon of the actions of Siva and his Sakti, they quaff the cup of love and stabilize in their own self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਸੁ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਸਾਂਤਕੋ ਤੀਨੋ ਲੰਘਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raajas taamas saa(n)tako teeno la(n)gh chauthaa padh paiaa|

en.bdb: Going beyond the three qualities of nature, the rajas, tamas and sattv, they attain the fourth stage of supreme equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਪੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੀਰੁ ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: guragovi(n)dh khudhai peer gursikh peer mureedh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Guru, Gobind and Khuda and Pir are all one, and the Sikhs of the Guru hold and know the inner truth of the Pir and Murid. i.e. the spiritual leader and the follower disciple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach sabadh paragaas kar sabadh surat sach sach milaiaa|

en.bdb: Enlightened by the true word and merging their consciousness in the Word they absorb their own truth into the supreme truth.
They love only the true emperor (Lord) and the truth.
